verdict.rationale: Earth Class Mail documents some product-run background automation. AI summaries and automatic labels categorize incoming mail without user action (docs-4, docs-9), and integrations keep documents and mail 'in sync' with other tools (docs-11). However, there is no evidence that users can define their own automation rules, triggers or workflows that then run unattended; the documented features are fixed behaviors or developer API building blocks. Missing for 10: user-configurable automation rules/triggers (e.g., auto-forward, auto-scan or auto-route by sender), documentation of how background integrations are set up and run, independent or hands-on corroboration.
